title: Code the approved mobile picks as routed variant pages (session page B, day list, task detail)
brief: Approved by vscode-mastermind 2026-10-22: picks in /framework/ai/sessions/doc/mobile-cards.md (wrapper card, flat rows one indent, day grouped by what needs you, session page B with Overview/Tasks/Chat, bar rules amber/red, light grey ground). Code as real routed pages the owner taps through on the phone, design process: design > review shots > pick > code as <page>/v/<name>/. Real session data, existing classes (Task/Session views); coordinate with the system architect (scaffolding the session menu). Sonnet builders in worktrees; mastermind reviews shots at 400; bring to ready-to-merge. Fold in Follow-up 2 where it fits (card header styles, swipeable tabs; figma-cards/requirements.md). Estimate ~$15. Owner: mastermind-figma-cards.
